BlaineIntroText:
BLAINE: Waaah!

My GYM in CINNABAR
burned down.

My fire-breathing
#MON and I are

homeless because
of the volcano.

Waaah!

But I'm back in
business as a GYM

LEADER here in
this cave.

If you can beat
me, I'll give you a BADGE.

Ha! You'd better
have BURN HEAL!
BlaineWinLossText:
BLAINE: Awesome.
I've burned out…

You've earned
VOLCANOBADGE!
BlaineAfterBattleText:
BLAINE: I did lose
this time, but I'm

going to win the
next time.

When I rebuild my
CINNABAR GYM,

we'll have to have
a rematch.
BlaineFightDoneText:
BLAINE: My fire
#MON will be

even stronger.
Just you watch!
SeafoamGymGuideWinText:
Yo!

… Huh? It's over
already?

Sorry, sorry!

CINNABAR GYM was
gone, so I didn't

know where to find
you.

But, hey, you're
plenty strong even

without my advice.
I knew you'd win!
SeafoamGymGuideWinText2:
A #MON GYM can
be anywhere as

long as the GYM
LEADER is there.

There's no need
for a building.
